function.name: lssproto_B_recv
function.signature: void lssproto_B_recv(int fd, const char* command)

dispatchKey.meaning: second byte of the complete battle command string

targetAbiParity.x86AndArmv7a: both expose C/P/A/U branches and the same default command-buffer fallback; no Z/F/O timer branches are present in the target function body

C.behavior: copy complete command string into a four-entry ring buffer for battle-status messages
C.targetEvidence: x86 computes base + pointer*0x1000, strcpy(command), then masks incremented pointer with 3

P.behavior: parse three hexadecimal integers from command+3
P.targetEvidence: x86 and ARMv7a both call the scanf-family routine with command+3 and three output destinations

A.behavior: parse two hexadecimal integers from command+3
A.secondaryCondition: when BattleTurnReceiveFlag is active, copy BattleSvTurnNo into BattleCliTurnNo and clear BattleTurnReceiveFlag
A.targetEvidence: x86 tests an adjacent one-byte flag after the scanf call, then copies the server turn field and clears that flag

default.behavior: copy complete command string into a four-entry ring buffer for battle command/result processing

versionBoundary.target: No Z/F/O branches are present in target lssproto_B_recv.
versionBoundary.crossSourceReference: Public BismarckDD/Stoneage source contains optional PK_SYSTEM_TIMER_BY_ZHU branches for Z/F/O.
versionBoundary.interpretation: Do not automatically port Z/F/O client turn-timer receive behavior into the target browser reconstruction without additional target evidence.

directUse: model BattleStatus as a four-slot 0x1000-byte receive ring
model server player-battle metadata P packet as three hexadecimal integers
model server animation/turn A packet as two hexadecimal integers plus conditional client-turn synchronization
model U packet as immediate escape-state assertion
route all other B commands into a separate four-slot command ring before battle processing
boundary: C/default ring entries are stored here but their downstream parsers are separate functions and are not semantically decoded by this contract.
BattleBpFlag and BattleAnimFlag exact bit meanings beyond their named client variables are not asserted from this receiver alone.
Server acceptance and battle-result formulas are outside this client receiver.
